traceability.evidence: Implementation – dual-position detection and fallback: - src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - gatherCatchClauseCommentText is dedicated to CatchClause behavior and explicitly tagged with this story and requirements: - JSDoc: `@story docs/stories/025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md`, `@req REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION`, `@req REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC`. - Logic: - Takes `beforeText` from `sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node)`. - If `beforeText` contains `@story` or `@req`, it returns `beforeText` immediately (before-catch position). - Else it attempts `getCommentsInside(node.body)` (when available) and joins their values as `insideText`. - If that fails or throws, it falls back to a line-based scan of the first comment-only lines inside `node.body` between `body.loc.start.line` and `body.loc.end.line`. - Returns `insideText` if non-empty, otherwise returns the original `beforeText`. - This directly satisfies: - REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION: checks both before-catch and inside-catch positions. - REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC: only falls back to inside-catch when before-catch does not contain annotations. - REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY: early return on before-catch annotations means they always take precedence. - gatherBranchCommentText: - For `node.type === "CatchClause"` it delegates to `gatherCatchClauseCommentText(sourceCode, node, beforeText)`, integrating the dual-position behavior into the general branch comment gathering pipeline. - src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts – auto-fix behavior: - getBaseBranchIndentAndInsertPos is documented with this story and supports requirements: - JSDoc includes: `@story docs/stories/025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md`, `@supports REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION`. - For `node.type === "CatchClause"`: - If the catch body has statements, it: - Finds the first statement's `loc.start.line`. - Derives `innerIndent` from that line's leading whitespace. - Sets `indent = innerIndent` and `insertPos` to the start of that line (`getIndexFromLoc`). - If the body is empty but has a block location, it: - Uses the block's line, derives `blockIndent`, then sets `innerIndent = `${blockIndent} `` (indent inside the block). - Sets `insertPos` at the block line. - reportMissingStory and reportMissingReq both use `{ indent, insertPos }` and insert text via `fixer.insertTextBeforeRange([insertPos, insertPos], ...)`, so for CatchClause these auto-fix comments go inside the catch body at the correct inner indentation. - This satisfies REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX by inserting annotations in the position Prettier preserves (inside the catch block).,Unit tests – CatchClause detection, fallback, and priority: - tests/utils/branch-annotation-catch-position.test.ts -
